doc_verification.detail: Documentation partially accessible: api.qdrant.tech domain blocked. structured_contract shows ef_construct range [10, 1000] at collection creation (qdrant_range_create_collection_002), but no explicit range documented for search-time hnsw_ef values or their relationship to ef_construct.

execution_evidence.log_pattern: INFO: Large hnsw_ef=1000000 accepted and returns 5 results | INFO: Small hnsw_ef=1 accepted and returns 5 results | Top 3 IDs with ef=10: [2, 3, 1] | Top 3 IDs with ef=100: [2, 3, 1] | INFO: Omitted params uses default, returns 3 results | DEFECT_FOUND (Type4_StateLogicViolation) — Top result should be id=1 (exact match), got 2
secondary_observations: EF value changes (1, 10, 100, 1000000) don't affect top-3 ranking consistency
Default params (no hnsw_ef) returns different result count (3 vs 5)

http_semantics.note: All hnsw_ef values (1, 10, 100, 1000000) accepted with 200 OK + results. No validation errors returned despite extreme values (1, 1000000) being outside reasonable HNSW ef ranges.

chain_trace.break_detail: Chain broken at doc+log: 1) Documentation lacks behavioral contract specifying hnsw_ef range relationship to ef_construct [10, 1000]. 2) Log shows state violation (exact match id=1 not ranked top) suggesting search quality issue independent of ef value. API accepts extreme values (ef=1, ef=1000000) violating expected HNSW parameters.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: SearchParams.hnsw_ef (unvalidated Option<usize>) → no runtime enforcement of [min, max] → CollectionParams.search_max_hnsw_ef optional (None by default) → search accepts any usize (1, 1000000). State logic violation (exact match not top) suggests separate ranking issue.

mundane_explanation.surviving: Two distinct issues: 1) Range validation absent (ef=1 and ef=1000000 accepted). 2) State logic violation (exact match id=1 not ranked top) - persists regardless of ef value, indicating search quality/ranking bug independent of parameter validation.
